name: Zermatt & the Swiss Alps
about: Winter is prime skiing, summer (Jun–Sep) is prime hiking, and the shoulder "mud season" sees many lifts and hotels close.
overview: A car-free alpine village beneath the Matterhorn's unmistakable pyramid.
costOverview: There's no cheap tier here — even a beer or a simple meal costs like a splurge would almost anywhere else.
